scope: Payment SPI field definitions and business constraints.
precedence: SDK source defines fields, types and runtime behavior. requirement/format describe business constraints that adapters must validate for each scenario.
sourcesPolicy: Field definitions come from the listed API materials. Nested objects and inheritance follow contracts.json.

order.description: Order information, including buyer, merchant, goods, amount and shipping, used for payment-risk assessment and subsequent tracing/reporting.
order.note: This does not imply that the adapter persists this information; use Order for its internal structure.

paymentRequestId.description: Unique payment request ID generated by APO, correlating the original request and enabling institution-side request idempotency.
paymentRequestId.note: Distinct from paymentId generated after institution acceptance; this does not automatically provide persistent platform idempotency.

paymentAmount.description: Payment amount the merchant requests to collect in the order currency.
paymentAmount.note: Represented in the smallest currency unit by Amount.value.

paymentFactor.description: Payment scenario and factors that affect payment processing.
paymentFactor.note: Provided for CARD, APPLEPAY, GOOGLEPAY and ONLINEBANKING_YAPILY, as identified by paymentMethod.paymentMethodType.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method and metadata used by the merchant/institution to collect funds.

paymentExpiryTime.description: Payment expires after this time and the corresponding order processing must end.
paymentExpiryTime.note: Use ISO 8601 for the deadline. The platform does not supply a universal validity period or automatically validate time limits.

paymentRedirectUrl.description: Merchant page to which the user is redirected after payment completion.
paymentRedirectUrl.note: Distinct from the institution API endpoint and the domain used by the platform to forward to iPay.

paymentNotifyUrl.description: Address for receiving asynchronous payment result notifications.
paymentNotifyUrl.note: Supply it according to the agreed notification flow. Capture notifications use a separate captureNotifyUrl. The platform provides no Dashboard configuration fallback.

env.description: Terminal, device and browser environment in which the user places the order.
env.note: Not the platform dev/prod or sandbox configuration; this field cannot replace the platform load-test context.

result.description: Standard result of this business call or notification, including status, error code and message; not an HTTP status.
result.note: Specific error codes are determined by platform result-code mapping configuration.

paymentId.description: Unique payment acceptance ID returned after the institution accepts the payment.

paymentAmount.description: Amount the institution expects to collect from the buyer for this payment.

paymentCreateTime.description: Creation time of the institution's payment record.
paymentCreateTime.note: Payment-record creation time, not the time payment reaches a successful final state.

normalUrl.requirement: Optional; applicable when payment requires further user action
normalUrl.description: Address for opening a WAP/WEB payment page in the default browser or an embedded WebView.
normalUrl.note: Return according to institution interaction when payment continuation or redirection is required; processing status does not always require a redirect.

paymentResultInfo.description: Additional payment result information, which may be returned for CARD.

orderCodeForm.description: Order-code information returned when the payment method supports it.

extendInfo.note: Java type is String, not Map; agree on the contents before mapping.

notes: Input BaseChannelRequest carries the institution's original payload and headers. Output PaymentNotifyRequest is the mapped standard payment notification for platform forwarding to iPay.
Payment, capture and refund notifications use separate SPI methods and must be mapped according to their own result semantics.
The platform handles notification ACKs using the actual iPay response. responseText belongs to NotifyResponse, not the notification SPI return type, and is not guaranteed to equal success.

notes: The input is an institution notification; output CaptureNotifyRequest is a standard capture notification. Do not mix their field structures.
The platform handles notification ACKs using the actual iPay response; confirm the institution's required ACK format during integration.

acknowledgementNote.description: Notification acknowledgment text parsed by the platform from the actual iPay response; not a NotificationService SPI return field and not a guaranteed fixed value.
